selection: Interim strict baseline: body uses installed original SimSun; heading/date/section labels retain the previously declared Arial400 fallback. The subsequently acquired official SimHei full face is queued for the separate natural-spacing edition, and is not claimed in these frozen PDFs.
new_prose_word_space: 0.25em for SimSun native prose before explicit reviewed local adjustments. No letter scaling. Original unselected whitespace operators unchanged.
native_preservation: Original mathematical glyphs/font programs and figures retained. Fixed point sizes/baselines and render states. No equation images, diagram replacement, reflow, shrinking, new edition labels or printed notes.
title_abbreviation: CPhO is the existing proper-name abbreviation for the Chinese national physics olympiad for secondary-school students. It retains the original one-line heading width and point size.
